items.title: Shadowed-floor Diviner extraction for CTRL2/CTRL3 (~18 full 240 m px each) to close the sunlit-vs-shadowed regime gap in the bias envelope
items.note: NOT ACHIEVABLE AS SCOPED. Measured permanently-shadowed extents (min-over-azimuth horizon vs each site's sun max): CTRL1 15.4 Diviner px, CTRL2 7.9, CTRL3 3.6, CTRL4 1.0 - CTRL2/3 are at or below PSR70's 9 px. Ordering is also reversed: CTRL1 (highest lat, lowest sun) has the largest shadowed floor. Further, NO dry shadowed control exists at this pole: of 680 never-lit components with Diviner coverage, 656 are <60 K, 24 are 60-110 K, and ZERO exceed 110 K - a never-lit floor is cold by construction. The sunlit-vs-shadowed gap is structural, not a data gap. Replaced by A16 (W1).

items.title: Run W1 as the warm shadowed control: 3.07 km floor at -84.80/43.82, Diviner median 90.0 K, 128 px at 240 m, 5202 facets / 0.22 GB / 11 min
items.note: closest available substitute for a dry shadowed control, which does not exist at this pole. Above ~110 K surface ice is unstable over Gyr so W1's top few cm are dry while the floor is genuinely never-lit. Validates the SURFACE energy balance only - ice may persist at depth, so not a subsurface control.

items.title: Tier 2 first runs: T1 (4.85 km, -88.92/150.60, 106-309 Diviner px/bin) then T2 (3.36 km, -89.63/-48.22, 78-133 px) at 120 m facets over a 2-diameter box, winter epoch, dry
items.note: 120 m puts 2 model facets per Diviner pixel linearly so the model block-averages onto the data grid with no interpolation. T1 1.38 GB / 2.0 h, T2 0.32 GB / 0.3 h. This is the first model-vs-Diviner comparison at a resolution where the comparison means anything.

items.title: Re-cut PSR70/170/183 floors from Bertone et al. 2026 SfS 5 m topography and test whether small-crater structure LOLA smoothed out changes the shadowed-floor geometry
items.note: ANSWERED NEGATIVELY, and not by re-running: SfS cannot constrain the PSR70 floor because photoclinometry needs light. GLDMASK shows the floor is seen by ZERO illuminated NAC images on 99.6% of its pixels (median 0) against a median of 26 off-floor. |SDEM-LDEM| scales with image count: 0.13 m at 0 images, 0.43-0.59 m at 1+. Floor sd is 0.251 m vs 0.935 m over the crop, and >1 m differences occur on 0.79% of floor vs 22.5% of crop. The floor stays LOLA-derived, so the small-crater question is unanswerable with this product and needs a different sensor.
